name: Boniface Strömberg-Nwosu
subcategory: retired legend / Ironwall League chrome football
description: Boniface Strömberg-Nwosu played fourteen seasons as a defensive anchor for the Harrowgate Ironbacks between 2183 and 2197, a Swedish-Igbo full-chrome defender whose reputation for controlled brutality within league rules made him the defining defensive player of the early Ironwall era. He retired with the most legal forced-exits in league history — a statistic that is either celebrated or horrifying depending on the district — and spent his post-career years as a notoriously frank pundit on Coldframe Corporate Media, a role he was quietly terminated from in 2211 after comparing a HelixCorp executive's labor practices to 'augmented indentured servitude' during a live broadcast.
story_hooks: Strömberg-Nwosu's claim about retained chrome monitoring turns out to be correct — and the data being collected is not biometric but something stranger, something that suggests HelixCorp has been running an undisclosed longitudinal study on long-term chrome-neural integration in retired athletes.
He is approached to testify in a class-action suit on behalf of forty-seven other Harrowgate Ironbacks players from his era who believe their retired augmentations have been similarly compromised.

A young journalist digging into his Coldframe termination discovers the HelixCorp executive he criticized on air had a direct financial interest in suppressing a specific piece of information that Boniface had, without knowing it, come close to revealing.
